result: At modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk@4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, Peer<RoleClient>::peer_info() returns cached handshake peer info without a network request. ServerPeerInfo includes ServerCapabilities, and ServerCapabilities::supports_tasks() checks the cached io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension. Peer<RoleClient>::get_task() itself directly sends tasks/get, while the exact-commit task_stdio example polls get_task without a server-capability preflight. Therefore a caller can implement a defensive zero-network preflight from peer_info before tasks/get; if a server returned a task while its cached handshake capabilities did not advertise tasks, that mismatch is locally detectable whenever peer_info is present. The SDK's current get_task path does not automatically enforce this check.
